build.buildCommand: sh -c 'APP=${RAILWAY_SERVICE_NAME#rabbitty-} && case "$APP" in bot) cd rabbit-bot && npm install ;; oracle) cd backend-oracle && npm install ;; *) pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile && node_modules/.bin/turbo run build --filter=@rabbitty/$APP ;; esac'

deploy.startCommand: sh -c 'APP=${RAILWAY_SERVICE_NAME#rabbitty-} && case "$APP" in bot) node rabbit-bot/dm-server.js ;; oracle) node backend-oracle/server.js ;; *) cd apps/$APP && npx next start ;; esac'
